successCriteria.description: The `LeaveRequest` entity interface is exported from `src/modules/leave-request/leave-request.model.ts` with all canonical fields: id, employeeId, leaveType (typed as `LeaveType`), startDate, endDate, reason, status (typed as `LeaveStatus`), approvedBy, approvedAt, rejectionReason, createdAt, updatedAt — matching the reconciled architecture entity definition.

The `ILeaveRequestRepository` interface declares all required methods: `findById`, `findByEmployeeId`, `findByStatus`, `findByManagerId`, `create`, `update`, and `updateStatus` — with signatures matching the phase specification and the `updateStatus` JSDoc documenting the allowed state transitions (DRAFT→SUBMITTED, SUBMITTED→APPROVED|REJECTED, SUBMITTED|APPROVED→CANCELLED).

The `ILeaveRequestService` interface declares all required methods: `submit`, `approve`, `reject`, `cancel`, `getById`, `getByEmployee`, `getPendingForManager` — each with JSDoc documenting its error contract (e.g., `submit` throws `LeaveRequestValidationError`; `approve`/`reject` throw `LeaveRequestNotFoundError`; `cancel` enforces self-cancellation).
The `CreateLeaveRequestDto` interface is exported with fields: employeeId (string), leaveType (LeaveType), startDate (Date), endDate (Date), reason (string, optional).

The `createLeaveRequestSchema` Zod schema validates that employeeId is a non-empty string, leaveType is one of the three `LeaveType` enum values, startDate and endDate are coerced to Date, reason is an optional string, and `startDate <= endDate` via `.refine()`.
The `updateLeaveRequestSchema` Zod schema allows partial updates with optional fields: leaveType, startDate, endDate, reason, status, approvedBy, approvedAt, rejectionReason — all optional.

Domain error classes `LeaveRequestNotFoundError` (code: `'NOT_FOUND'`) and `LeaveRequestValidationError` (code: `'VALIDATION_ERROR'`) are exported from `leave-request.model.ts`, following the same pattern as `BalanceNotFoundError` and `InsufficientBalanceError` in the balance module.

The `Notification` entity interface is exported from `src/modules/notification/notification.model.ts` with all canonical fields: id, recipientId, type (typed as `NotificationType`), title, message, relatedEntityType, relatedEntityId, status (typed as `NotificationStatus`), createdAt, readAt — matching the reconciled architecture entity definition.
The `INotificationRepository` interface declares all required methods: `findByRecipientId`, `findByRecipientIdAndStatus`, `create`, `updateStatus` — with signatures matching the phase specification.

The `INotificationService` interface declares all required methods: `notifyLeaveSubmitted`, `notifyLeaveApproved`, `notifyLeaveRejected`, `notifyLeaveCancelled`, `getNotifications`, `markAsRead` — each `notify*` method accepts a `LeaveRequest` parameter and returns `Promise<Notification>`, with JSDoc documenting that `relatedEntityType` is set to `'leave_request'` and `relatedEntityId` to `leaveRequest.id`.

constraints: This phase produces ONLY interfaces, DTOs, Zod schemas, and error classes — NO concrete repository or service implementations. The files `leave-request.repository.ts`, `leave-request.service.ts`, `leave-request.controller.ts`, `leave-request.routes.ts`, `notification.repository.ts`, and `notification.service.ts` are out of scope for this phase and belong to Phase 6 (part 2/2).
No test files are produced in this phase. Tests for the leave-request and notification modules belong to Phase 6 (part 2/2).

The `Notification` model's import of `LeaveRequest` from `../leave-request/leave-request.model` MUST be a type-only import (`import type { LeaveRequest }`). This prevents a runtime circular dependency when the notification service is later consumed by the leave-request service.

All enum-typed fields must use the shared enum types from `src/shared/types/index.ts` — `LeaveType`, `LeaveStatus`, `NotificationType`, `NotificationStatus` — not string literals. The Zod schemas must use `z.enum()` with the enum values, not `z.string()`.

Error classes must follow the established pattern from the balance module: extend `Error`, expose a readonly `code` property (e.g., `'NOT_FOUND'`, `'VALIDATION_ERROR'`), and set `this.name` to the class name in the constructor.
outOfScope: Concrete repository implementations (`PgLeaveRequestRepository`, `PgNotificationRepository`) — these belong to Phase 6 (part 2/2).
Concrete service implementations (`LeaveRequestService`, `NotificationService`) — these belong to Phase 6 (part 2/2).
Controller and route definitions (`LeaveRequestController`, `LeaveRequest routes`, notification routes) — these belong to Phase 6 (part 2/2).

entityInvariants.invariant: A LeaveRequest's `status` field governs its lifecycle. The only allowed transitions are: DRAFT → SUBMITTED; SUBMITTED → APPROVED | REJECTED; SUBMITTED | APPROVED → CANCELLED. REJECTED and CANCELLED are terminal states — no further transitions are permitted from either. The `updateStatus` repository method is the sole mutator of status and must enforce these transitions.

When a LeaveRequest transitions to APPROVED, `approvedBy` must be set to the approver's employee ID and `approvedAt` must be set to the current timestamp. When transitioning to REJECTED, `rejectionReason` must be a non-empty string. When transitioning to CANCELLED, the `employeeId` of the caller must match the request's `employeeId` (self-cancellation only).
`startDate` must be on or before `endDate`. This is enforced by the `createLeaveRequestSchema` Zod `.refine()` and must also be enforced by any update path that modifies dates.

Every Notification created by the `INotificationService.notify*` methods must have `relatedEntityType` set to `'leave_request'` and `relatedEntityId` set to the `LeaveRequest.id` that triggered the event. The `type` field must match the corresponding `NotificationType` enum value for the lifecycle event.

A Notification's `status` transitions from its initial value (typically `pending` or `sent`) to `read` when `markAsRead` is called. The `readAt` timestamp must be set to the current time when the status transitions to `read`.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at the repository layer — authorization is enforced at the service/controller layer.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns `null` when no request with the given id exists (caller must throw `LeaveRequestNotFoundError`). Must reject invalid state transitions — the implementation in part 2/2 must throw a domain error for disallowed transitions.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller identity is passed via the DTO's employeeId field; the service layer in part 2/2 must verify the authenticated user matches or has HR admin role.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws `LeaveRequestValidationError` for schema validation failures. Throws domain errors for business rule violations: insufficient balance (propagated from IBalanceService), inactive employee, overlapping request, or policy violation.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: The approverId must be the manager of the employee who submitted the request (or an HR admin). Enforced at the service layer in part 2/2.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws `LeaveRequestNotFoundError` if the request does not exist. Throws a domain error if the request is not in 'submitted' status.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: The approverId must be the manager of the employee who submitted the request (or an HR admin). Enforced at the service layer in part 2/2.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws `LeaveRequestNotFoundError` if the request does not exist. Throws a domain error if the request is not in 'submitted' status. Throws `LeaveRequestValidationError` if the rejection reason is empty.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Self-cancellation only: the employeeId parameter must match the request's employeeId. Enforced at the service layer in part 2/2.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws `LeaveRequestNotFoundError` if the request does not exist. Throws a domain error if the request is not in 'submitted' or 'approved' status. Throws a domain error if employeeId does not match the request's employeeId.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: The caller must be the notification's recipient. Enforced at the service layer in part 2/2.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: If the notification is already in 'read' status, the operation should succeed without error (idempotent). If the notification does not exist, throws a domain error.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `LeaveRequest.leaveType` field must use the `LeaveType` enum imported from `src/shared/types/index.ts`. The `LeaveRequest.status` field must use the `LeaveStatus` enum from the same module. No string literals for these fields.
The `Notification.type` field must use the `NotificationType` enum and `Notification.status` must use the `NotificationStatus` enum, both imported from `src/shared/types/index.ts`.

Error classes (`LeaveRequestNotFoundError`, `LeaveRequestValidationError`) must follow the exact same pattern as `BalanceNotFoundError` and `InsufficientBalanceError` in `src/modules/balance/balance.model.ts`: extend `Error`, expose a readonly `code` property, set `this.name` in the constructor.

The `ILeaveRequestService` interface's `submit` method must accept a `CreateLeaveRequestDto` and the service implementation in part 2/2 must calculate leave duration using the binding rule: calendar days inclusive — `(endDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24) + 1`. This rule is documented in the reconciled architecture and must be applied consistently.

The `ILeaveRequestRepository.updateStatus` method's allowed state transitions (DRAFT→SUBMITTED, SUBMITTED→APPROVED|REJECTED, SUBMITTED|APPROVED→CANCELLED) must match the lifecycle documented in the reconciled architecture's `LeaveRequest` entity purpose: "Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through approval/rejection to cancellation."

integrationPoints.why: Both `leave-request.model.ts` and `notification.model.ts` import shared enums (`LeaveType`, `LeaveStatus`, `NotificationType`, `NotificationStatus`) from this module. All enum-typed fields in entities, DTOs, and Zod schemas depend on these exact enum definitions.

`LeaveRequest.employeeId` references an Employee. The `ILeaveRequestRepository.findByManagerId` method requires joining on `Employee.managerId`. The `ILeaveRequestService` must validate that the employee exists and is active before allowing submission.

`ILeaveRequestService.submit` must call `ILeavePolicyService.validateEntitlement` to check that the requested leave type is valid and the requested days do not exceed the policy's entitlement. The `LeaveRequest.leaveType` must correspond to a `LeavePolicy.leaveType`.

`ILeaveRequestService.submit` must call `IBalanceService.hasSufficientBalance` before creating the request. `ILeaveRequestService.approve` must call `IBalanceService.deductBalance` to decrement used days. `ILeaveRequestService.cancel` (of an approved request) must restore balance days.
Every state-changing operation in `ILeaveRequestService` (submit, approve, reject, cancel) must write an audit record via `IAuditLogRepository.create`, per GP-002.
